## Tasting   Notes

- ![](https://www.fourrosesbourbon.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffour-roses.files.svdcdn.com%2Fproduction%2Fimages%2Fbourbons%2FVertical_AllSpice_1.jpg%3Fdm%3D1757960446&w=2560&q=75)





### Nose





Introduces warm aromas of allspice and vanilla bean, mingled with rich apricot and stewed fruits.

- ![](https://www.fourrosesbourbon.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffour-roses.files.svdcdn.com%2Fproduction%2Fimages%2Fbourbons%2FVertical_Raspberry.jpg%3Fdm%3D1757960457&w=2560&q=75)





### Palate





Bright raspberry flavors greet the palate, then give way to hints of decadent, swee maraschino cherry and light oak.

- ![](https://www.fourrosesbourbon.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffour-roses.files.svdcdn.com%2Fproduction%2Fimages%2Fbourbons%2FVertical_Cinnamon_1.jpg%3Fdm%3D1757960454&w=2560&q=75)





### Finish





The finish is long, with notes of rich brown sugar and hints of cinnamon.
